about.text: Foodstuff made of cottage cheese, caraway and other ingredients, which are mixed, put aside for a few days to acquire the characteristic sharp flavor and tacky consistency, and then warmed and fried.

sources.text: Cottage cheese rested a few days with caraway, then cooked with egg and butter into a mass and pressed (Kochkäse-like); Polish traditional product
